title: Luzon faces higher power rates in November

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consumers in Luzon may see an increase in their power bills this month as the electricity prices traded at the spot market surged by 51.2 percent to P7.83 per kilowatt-hour (kWh). On Wednesday, Independent Electricity Market Operator of the Philippines’ (IEMOP) data showed that Luzon’s supply dipped by 0.9 percent to 14,972 megawatts (MW). Its demand, meanwhile, rose by 6.9 percent to 10,580 MW.
